metadata.defaultTitle: SafeSiso — Confidential SRH support for girls in Northern Ghana
metadata.defaultDescription: SafeSiso is a confidential, AI-powered WhatsApp service giving adolescent girls in Northern Ghana shame-free sexual and reproductive health information, and referral to verified SafeHer safe spaces. No registration, no real name, no location.

common.startChat: Start a Private Chat on WhatsApp
common.chatUnavailableHelp: The SafeSiso WhatsApp number has not been connected yet. This button will work as soon as it is.

footer.tagline: Confidential, shame-free sexual and reproductive health information for adolescent girls in Northern Ghana.
footer.promise: No registration, no real name, no location disclosure, ever.
footer.backing: SafeSiso is a pilot funded through the AI for Her Future Innovation Hackathon Seed Fund, supported by UNFPA Ghana and the Government of Canada, and delivered in partnership with the Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG).
footer.dpcLabel: Registered with Ghana's Data Protection Commission:
footer.safetyNoticeHeading: SafeSiso is not an emergency service
footer.safetyNotice: SafeSiso gives information and can connect you to a safe space near you. It cannot replace a doctor, a counsellor, or the police. If you are in immediate danger, get help from a trusted adult or the emergency services right away.
footer.safetyNoticeLink: Read what SafeSiso can and cannot do
